job.title: Technology Operations Analyst
job.description: Wells Fargo Technology Operations Analyst in Greater Hyderabad Area. Responsibilities: support business-solution implementation; assess impact of hardware, software, and schedule changes; review tactical issues and procedures; perform daily application validations and critical functional checks; monitor scheduled batch jobs and fix failures; audit critical systems delivery; evaluate product and tool changes; reduce impact of application and infrastructure failures; recommend resolutions; and provide technology information to managers and stakeholders. Required: 2+ years of Technology Operations experience or equivalent work, training, military experience, or education. Desired: system administration, desktop troubleshooting, Windows 7/10/11, Cisco and LAN/WAN networking, Windows Server, incident and problem management, Apple systems and hardware, Active Directory, Exchange, Office 365, Intune MDM, network/firewall/printer maintenance, mobile device setup, SLA management, technical support, ITIL, VMware, Azure, ServiceNow, and OS troubleshooting. Minimum degree and ITIL certification listed. Posting end date: 30 Aug 2026. LinkedIn showed full-time, posted/reposted 2 days ago, responses managed off LinkedIn. JD read from authenticated LinkedIn job-detail pane on 2026-08-14.

resume.title: Technology Operations / Production Support Engineer (tailored for Wells Fargo Technology Operations Analyst)
resume.summary: Production support engineer with nearly 3 years’ combined technology-operations experience supporting 24/7 enterprise applications. Professionally managed incident and ticket workflows in ServiceNow, triaged 8–10 production incidents daily with ~98.6% SLA adherence, monitored and remediated scheduled batch jobs (Control‑M), and participated in UAT/release validation. Built Python automation and runbooks to standardize release checks and reduce manual validation time. Comfortable troubleshooting Unix/Linux stacks, Oracle/PLSQL-backed applications, REST APIs, and cloud-hosted application issues.
skills: Incident & on-call support (L1/L2), RCA, SLA management
Python scripting and automation (production health checks, log parsing, reporting)
Oracle SQL / PL/SQL for application-data investigation
REST APIs / JSON / Postman for integration troubleshooting
UAT and release validation (defect reproduction, smoke checks)
Monitoring, log analysis and production-release verification
Power BI, Power Query, SQL (operational reporting) — IGT context
Networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Wi‑Fi, VPN (support context)

experience.title: Product Support Engineer
bullets: Provided L1/L2 production support and ticket triage using ServiceNow for a workforce/time-and-attendance application; managed incident lifecycle, escalations, and SLA-driven resolution handoffs.

Triaged and resolved 8–10 production incidents daily (application failures, batch/Control‑M processing issues, data inconsistencies and performance degradations), maintaining ~98.6% SLA compliance through prioritized incident handling and escalation.

Built Python automation for production health checks, log parsing, ServiceNow reporting, Control‑M job validation, and release verification to standardize release validation and reduce routine verification time.
Investigated application and data issues using Oracle SQL / PL/SQL and Unix/Linux log analysis; performed query tuning and data reconciliation to support incident resolution.

Validated REST API integrations and performed smoke testing during ~12–15 production releases using Postman and Python scripts; documented release outcomes and coordinated rollback/escalation as needed.
Authored and maintained SOPs and runbooks for troubleshooting and operational workflows; onboarded and mentored a new support engineer on incident handling, SQL checks and Linux fundamentals.

experience.title: Technical Operations Analyst
bullets: Served as primary technical point of contact for reservation-platform issues impacting global hotel operations, coordinating stakeholders and technical teams to resolve platform incidents.
Automated operational reporting and data validation using Python, SQL and Power Query; built Power BI dashboards to track reservation accuracy and SLA compliance.
Participated in REST API testing between reservation and payment systems and in UAT activities for production releases, documenting test outcomes and defect reproduction steps.
Used Salesforce as an operational/work-management tool to monitor work items and update case notes (professional operational use; not platform administration).
Documented workflows and created SOPs to reduce manual effort in backend reservation and event operations.

experience.title: Technical Support Representative
bullets: Provided first-line technical troubleshooting for Comcast/Xfinity connectivity, modem, Wi‑Fi and service issues, consistently meeting quality metrics and CSAT targets.
Troubleshot networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN and Wi‑Fi in a high-volume support environment.
Created and updated CRM/ticketing support cases while documenting resolutions and contributing knowledge-base content to standardize troubleshooting steps.
Developed personal Linux home-lab and Python log-analysis scripts to strengthen enterprise support and automation skills.

education: Bachelor of Commerce (Accounting Hons), North Orissa University, 20182021
